# FitNotes' default exercise names, used as data in tests (review r5).
# Source: ikkani/Fitnotes2Hevy, files/fitnotes_exercises.txt (fetched 2026-10-09). Its README says the
# file lists all the default exercises of FitNotes. Its Spanish entries are that user's own and are left
# out, with the two unpaired entries "Abductor" / "Aductor"; the 92 English names are kept as written.
# The last 5 names are FitNotes defaults seen in the real 2020 export cited in
# docs/research/fitnotes-export-format.md §4 (moferg) that the list above doesn't have.
